name: PagerDuty V2
description: The Sumo Logic App for PagerDuty V2 collects incident messages from your PagerDuty account via a webhook, and displays that incident data in pre-configured Dashboards, so you can monitor and analyze the activity of your PagerDuty account and Services. The Sumo Logic App for PagerDuty V2 uses Webhooks V2, providing enhanced context for alert object models.

children.name: PagerDuty V2 - Incidents Overview
children.description: The Incidents Overview Dashboard provides an at-a-glance analysis of triggered, acknowledged, escalated, assigned, and resolved incidents. This dashboard also provides a high-level view of incident trends and comparisons over specified time intervals.

panels.name: Incidents Breakdown by Type
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/pagerduty_v2  
| parse regex "(?<event>\{\"event\":\"incident\..+?\}(?=,\{\"event\":\"incident\..+|\]\}$))" multi
| json  field=event "event","log_entries", "created_on", "incident", "webhook" 
| json field=incident "id", "incident_number", "escalation_policy.summary", "service.name" , "impacted_services[*].summary", "status", "summary", "description", "title", "urgency", "teams[0].summary", "assignments[*].assignee" as incident_id, incident_number, escalation_policy_name, alertedBy_service, impacted_service, incident_status, incident_summary, incident_description, incident_tittle, incident_urgency,  incident_team_involved, assignee 
| parse regex field=assignee "summary\":\"(?<assigned_user>.+?)\"" multi
| count by event
| sort by _count
